displayName: Repurpose my latest LinkedIn posts into new content
summary: Turn your best LinkedIn posts into newsletters, X threads, or video scripts.

useCases.title: Repurpose my latest LinkedIn posts into new content
useCases.message: Help me repurpose my recent LinkedIn posts. Ask me how many to pull and what formats to create. Then go to my LinkedIn profile, read the latest posts, and draft each new format. Ask me where to send or save the output when done.
